scripts.deploy: npm run db:migrate:self-host && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.toml
scripts.db:migrate: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --config wrangler.toml
scripts.db:migrate:self-host: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config wrangler.toml

API_KEY.description: Required bearer token for agents. Generate a long random value, for example with `openssl rand -hex 32`.

OWNER_EMAIL.description: Required email address for the first and only owner account.

WORKER_URL.description: Required final HTTPS origin for this Worker, with no trailing slash. Update the example after choosing the Worker name.

RESEND_API_KEY.description: Optional. Enables magic-link email without configuring Cloudflare Email Routing.

RESEND_FROM.description: Optional verified sender used with RESEND_API_KEY.

APNS_PRIVATE_KEY.description: Optional. Push requires credentials for an Apple app signed by your own developer team.

TYPESAFE_API_KEY.description: Optional. A TypeSafe API key turns on JEV library search, cited answers, and filing suggestions.
